folderize.description: A project manager for VS Code: browse, organize and quickly open your development projects from one or more root folders.
folderize.color.openFolderForeground: Color of the project currently open in Folderize
folderize.viewsWelcome.projects:
No projects added yet.
[Add project](command:folderize.addProject)
[Add root folder](command:folderize.addRootFolder)
folderize.viewsWelcome.recents: Your recently opened projects will appear here.
folderize.config.rootFolders: Absolute paths to root folders. Each immediate subfolder is listed as a project.
folderize.config.projects: Absolute paths to individually added projects (subfolders are not scanned).
folderize.config.categories: Categories created to organize projects in the sidebar.
folderize.config.uncategorizedPosition: Position of the 'Uncategorized' group in the category order (-1 = at the end). Managed by the extension.
folderize.config.projectMeta: Per-project metadata (category, order, favorite, display name). Managed by the extension.
folderize.config.excludedPaths: Scanned subfolder paths that were removed from the listing.
